_doc: Shared by velaris_shared/forms/validate.py (pytest) and studio form-builder/validate.ts (vitest). Each case: the form's fields (one section), the submitted values, the expected errors {field_key: message}, and optionally the expected stored values. Cases with "today" pin the date relative bounds are counted from.
